summary.text: Cyndy Jacobsen is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 25-Position 2 since January 11, 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes work as an educator, accountant and real estate entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Jacobsen earned a bachelor's degree from Western Washington University in 1982 and a master's degree from Central Washington University in 2010.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a Puyallup City Council member who teaches math at Pierce College, has lived in the district for more than three decades and raised seven children.
The same survey listed holding the line on taxes and promoting economic development among her key messages.

During the 2023-2024 session, Jacobsen was assigned to the Finance Committee, the House Local Government Committee, the College & Workforce Development Committee and the House Rules Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
